script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: forgiveness

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - DAY

A cheerful HIGH SCHOOL COACH, JEN, sits on the bleachers, looking on proudly as her cheerleading squad practices. A disinterested, overweight FIFTEEN-YEAR-OLD GIRL, MILA, drags her feet through the bleachers, glancing at her phone.

MILA
(mumbled)
Just five more minutes, Mom.

Her phone buzzes with a text from her mother.

TEXT: Mila, please don't disappoint me again.

MILA
(defeated)
Fine.

She trudges over to the cheerleading squad and joins in, unenthusiastically.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL CAFETERIA - LATER

Mila sits alone at a table, eating lunch. A popular, athletic GIRL, NATALIE, approaches and sits down across from her.

NATALIE
(sarcastically)
Looks like you're still not interested in cheerleading.

MILA
(angrily)
I didn't quit, you were just kicked off.

Natalie laughs and sits down, unfazed.

NATALIE
(smirking)
Really? That's what you're telling yourself.

MILA
(sadly)
It's the truth.

NATALIE
(sighs)
Mila, I've been watching you. You've got something special. You're holding yourself back because of what happened with Coach Jen?

MILA
(resigned)
I just don't have what it takes.

NATALIE
(smiling)
I believe in you. I want to help you.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - AFTER SCHOOL

Mila and Natalie practice cheerleading moves in the empty gym. Mila is hesitant and self-conscious, but Natalie encourages and guides her.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL LIBRARY - NIGHT

Jen sits at a table, grading papers, when she notices Mila entering the library. She looks up and sees the disappointment in Mila's eyes.

JEN
(calling out)
Mila! What are you doing here?

MILA
(nervously)
I just wanted to talk to you.

JEN
(surprised)
About what?

MILA
(hesitantly)
I'm sorry for quitting the cheerleading squad. I didn't mean to hurt you.

Jen looks at Mila with a mix of surprise and emotion.

JEN
(tearfully)
Mila, I was disappointed, but I never hated you. I believed in you and I still do.

MILA
(tearfully)
I want to try again. Can I join the squad?

Jen smiles and nods.

JEN
(smiling)
Yes, of course.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL GYMNASIUM - DAY

Mila practices with the cheerleading squad, determined and focused. She looks at Jen, who is proudly watching her from the sidelines.

INT. HIGH SCHOOL STADIUM - NIGHT

The school's football team plays against a rival team. The cheerleading squad performs, including Mila. She cheers with enthusiasm and pride, her eyes meeting Natalie's as they perform a difficult move together.

As the crowd cheers, Mila looks up at the stars, feeling a sense of forgiveness and redemption.

FADE OUT.

THE END.
